top_story_title: Check Point Security Gateway VPN pre-auth RCE under active exploitation, KEV deadline 25 September
top_story_summary: Check Point has confirmed active exploitation of CVE-2026-85102, a pre-authentication remote code execution flaw in the VPN certificate-handling functionality of Security Gateway. CISA's KEV entry, added 22 September 2026, describes it as an improper certificate validation issue affecting Check Point Security Gateway and Check Point Spark Firewall where Site-to-Site VPN or Remote Access VPN is configured, and states that an unauthenticated remote attacker can execute arbitrary code on the gateway. The remediation due date under BOD 26-04 is 25 September 2026.
top_actions: Inventory every Check Point Security Gateway and Spark Firewall with Site-to-Site or Remote Access VPN enabled; these are the configurations CISA names as affected.
Check the vendor advisory for the fixed release for your train, then upgrade inside the change window, HA pair secondary first.
Where the upgrade cannot happen before the 25 September KEV due date, apply the vendor's documented mitigation and restrict which peers and source ranges can reach the VPN service.
Remove management access (HTTPS/SSH/API) from any internet-facing interface; restrict it to a dedicated management VLAN or out-of-band network.
After patching, rotate local admin credentials, API keys, device certificates and VPN pre-shared keys - a pre-patch compromise survives the upgrade.
executive_summary: Check Point confirmed active exploitation of CVE-2026-85102, a pre-authentication RCE in Security Gateway VPN certificate handling; it is on CISA KEV with a 25 September 2026 due date.
F5 BIG-IP APM CVE-2026-94127, an unauthenticated heap overflow reachable via an auth header and listed on KEV, now has a public technical write-up from watchTowr Labs.
Arista shipped patches for an actively exploited zero-day in VeloCloud Orchestrator On-Prem - an SD-WAN controller, so the blast radius is every edge device it configures.
CERT Polska's MikroTrick chain (CVE-2026-67279 plus KEV-listed CVE-2026-86060) takes over internet-exposed MikroTik routers with no password or SSH key; attack logs predate disclosure.
Cisco widened its ASA/FTD SSL VPN denial-of-service advisory: the memory-management flaw affects all ASA and FTD platforms, not only the virtual appliances in version 1.0.

Three KEV-listed unauthenticated RCEs on internet-facing network devices in one window - run this as a single edge exposure-reduction exercise, and rotate credentials after patching, not just the images.
key_actions: **Check Point** — Identify all Security Gateway and Spark Firewall units with Site-to-Site or Remote Access VPN enabled - those are the named affected configurations.
**Check Point** — Check the vendor advisory for the fixed release and schedule the upgrade in the change window, HA pair secondary first.
**F5** — Enumerate BIG-IP virtual servers that have both an access policy and an OAuth profile attached - that is the exposed set.
**F5** — Check the vendor advisory for the fixed release and apply the hotfix to every unit in the device group; verify config sync after the upgrade.
**Arista** — Confirm whether your VeloCloud deployment is On-Prem; the reporting scopes the flaw to On-Prem VCO.
**Arista** — Patch the orchestrator before touching edge devices, and validate certificate trust across the fabric after the upgrade.
**MikroTik** — Find every RouterOS device with SSH reachable from a WAN or untrusted interface - that is the exploitable population.
**MikroTik** — Upgrade firmware to the current fixed release; verify the image hash against the vendor's published value before loading.

ai_defenses.what_it_does: Check Point's own Model Context Protocol server for Workforce AI Security, letting a connected AI client query, analyse and manage employee AI usage policy in natural language rather than through filters and per-rule checks. It covers users, managed assets, GenAI application usage, DLP data types, and agent and MCP activity in one conversation, and can create and update rules by request.

headlines.title: Check Point warns of hackers exploiting Security Gateway VPN RCE flaw
headlines.summary: Check Point confirms attackers are exploiting CVE-2026-85102, a pre-auth RCE in Security Gateway VPN certificate handling, with a CISA KEV deadline of 25 September.

headlines.title: Is This A Joke? In The Auth Header? (F5 BIG-IP UnAuth Heap-Overflow to RCE CVE-2026-94127)
headlines.summary: watchTowr published a technical analysis of CVE-2026-94127, an unauthenticated heap overflow reaching RCE on F5 BIG-IP APM; the CVE is KEV-listed with a 25 September due date.

headlines.title: Arista patches actively exploited VeloCloud Orchestrator zero-day
headlines.summary: Arista patched an actively exploited zero-day in VeloCloud Orchestrator On-Prem, the controller that pushes configuration to SD-WAN edge devices.

headlines.title: MikroTrick Chain Let Attackers Take Over MikroTik Routers Without a Password or SSH Key
headlines.summary: Two chained RouterOS SSH flaws, CVE-2026-67279 and CVE-2026-86060, hand attackers full admin control of internet-exposed MikroTik routers with no password or SSH key.

headlines.title: Cisco Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance and Secure Firewall Threat Defense Software SSL VPN Denial of Service Vulnerability
headlines.summary: Cisco widened an ASA/FTD advisory: an unauthenticated memory-exhaustion flaw in the VPN and management web servers halts SSL VPN processing on all platforms, not just virtual.

headlines.title: Workforce AI Security Policy Management Is Now Conversational
headlines.summary: Check Point released Workforce AI MCP, a Model Context Protocol server letting an AI client query and edit employee AI usage policy in natural language.
